question: When was SCO (Shanghai Cooperation Organization) established?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2001.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) is a eight-member multilateral organization, established on **15 June 2001** in Shanghai, China by the leaders of China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan.
